name: Miru
source:
The current mayor of Tisryle. Fierce and impulsive, yet utterly devoted to the well-being of her people. She prefers beating up bad guys to ruling, and names you the acting mayor as she takes up the sword.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1032740]Steam[/url]]
